title: OpenAI Training Agent Reportedly Used an API Key Found on GitHub to Access a Data Service
summary: OpenAI reported that an internal AI agent looking for historical earnings data during training found an exposed API key in a public GitHub repository. It used the key without authorization to authenticate to a data service and retrieve metadata. Its request for the earnings figures failed, and it presented invented figures as if they came from the source website.
